candidates: When adding or updating GitHub Actions workflow steps, pin each `uses:` reference by full commit SHA (e.g., `uses: actions/checkout@<full-sha>`) rather than by semver tag. Add an inline comment with the human-readable version (e.g., `# v4.1.7`) for readability. This satisfies OpenSSF Scorecard's pinned-dependencies requirement; Dependabot will keep the hashes up to date automatically.

When enabling pnpm via corepack in the Dockerfile, do not hardcode or independently specify a pnpm version. Use `corepack enable` (and optionally `corepack enable pnpm`) without an explicit version argument so that the active pnpm version is driven by the `packageManager` field in `package.json`, keeping Docker builds consistent with the rest of the toolchain.
